claim: A subtype of anti-nuclear antibodies are anti-centromere antibodies.

symbolic.claim: A subtype of anti-nuclear antibodies are anti-centromere antibodies.

evidence.text: Anti-centromere antibodies -LRB- ACAs ; often styled solid , anticentromere -RRB- are autoantibodies specific to centromere and kinetochore function .
Anti-centromere antibodies are found in approximately 60 % of patients with limited systemic scleroderma and in 15 % of those with the diffuse form of scleroderma .

Anti-centromere antibodies present early in the course of disease and are notably predictive of limited cutaneous involvement and a decreased likelihood of aggressive internal organ involvement , such as fibrosis in the lungs .
Anti-dsDNA antibodies are a group of anti-nuclear antibodies -LRB- ANA -RRB- and their target antigen is double stranded DNA .
Thus , a positive anti-centromere antibody finding is strongly suggestive of limited systemic scleroderma .
